stories.title: At least 1,500 missing after deadly Nepal-Tibet floods
stories.reason: A glacier collapse sent a wall of water and debris through a Himalayan valley, killing 360+ and leaving nearly 1,500 missing including hundreds of foreign tourists.

stories.title: Iran, Oman ministers hold 'constructive' Strait of Hormuz talks
stories.reason: The talks toward a joint shipping arrangement come as a second tanker was struck by a projectile in the Strait, underscoring how fragile the de-escalation still is.

stories.title: Nvidia agrees to buy Hugging Face for $12.9 billion, reports say
stories.reason: The deal would push Nvidia beyond chips into the open-source model ecosystem millions of developers rely on, though the agreement isn't yet finalized.

stories.title: Stock Market Today (Aug. 27, 2026): S&P 500 climbs after Nvidia earnings beat
stories.reason: Nvidia jumped 8.5% and lifted the broader market, with the Nasdaq up 1.5% as Wall Street also looked ahead to the Fed's next move.

stories.title: Salesforce Soars 14% as Claudeforce and a Guidance Raise End the Slump, ServiceNow Climbs 5%, Adobe Advances 3%
stories.reason: Okta and CrowdStrike also surged over 18% on agentic-AI security demand, capping a broad enterprise-software rally alongside Nvidia's earnings.
